Dialogs.Dialog: Hey, I heard you've gotten close with a first-year on the library committee lately？
Hey, I heard you've gotten close with an older girl at your part-time job lately？
Well... I guess you'd call it youth... that's how it feels. But don't overdo it, okay？
Are you getting along with the first-year on the library committee？
Are you getting along with the older girl at your part-time job？
Um, it might not be any of my business, but...
You have to keep a proper, decent relationship, like high schoolers should！
What's up？ What are you doing here？
I was remembering all sorts of things...
The first time I met you here...
And all the things you did for me after that...
Did I really do that much？
You did... lots for me, you know？
I see. As long as I wasn't a bother, I'm glad...
No way！ You were never a bother...
You don't have to be by my side forever... but I'd like you to keep showing me new worlds.
Thank you. Please keep taking care of me... from now on too.
If you're looking for Takane, she went off to the courts by herself a little while ago？
Um, you're the one from the other day...
This might not be my place, but at Dixie's, Takane was crying, you know？
(It reminds me of when ▲高嶺＊＊▲ confessed to me...)
Hey, we're going to Menra, Menra！
I knew it... um, sorry, but...
I'm sorry... but I want it to be just the two of us.
Huh!? So you two really are...
Uh, y-yeah... let's go over there, guys！
What's gotten into you, all of a sudden...
(It reminds me of when ▲高嶺＊＊▲ confessed to me...)
I don't get it, why a guy like him...
Hey, want to... go over to the courts？
(It reminds me of when ▲高嶺＊＊▲ confessed to me...)
If you're looking for Takane, she went off to the courts by herself a little while ago？
Um, you're the one from the other day...
This might not be my place, but at Dixie's, Takane was crying, you know？
Okay, that's enough. You can't, you have a girlfriend.
(Having a dream like that... I feel bad for my girlfriend.)
I've changed a little, haven't I？
I think I have... look more closely？ Not on the outside, but on the inside.
I've been trying to be more serious, like I used to be.
▲高嶺＊＊▲'s always serious... but yeah, I guess so. But why？
Well... I thought you might like me better that way.
(A serious ▲高嶺＊＊▲... yeah, I like it.)
You know, I... don't you feel like I've changed a little？
Um, not how I look... I mean on the inside.
On the inside... come to think of it, you seem quieter？
Yes. I thought I'd try being more calm and composed.
No real reason. I just thought you might like me better that way.
Hey, hey, my vibe's changed, hasn't it？
Ah, hehe. I thought I'd try acting more cheerful than before. Do you mind？
No particular reason. I just had a feeling you might like me better that way.
Hey, ▲高嶺＊＊▲. ▲高嶺＊＊▲ doesn't go downtown at night, right？
What？ Of course not. I'm in high school, you know？
I saw an underclassman of mine there, so I was a little worried.
Hey, ▲高嶺＊＊▲. What would it mean if someone came to school after hours in street clothes？
Huh, that's against school rules, you know？
Well, of course it is, but maybe there's some reason...
A reason... hmm. Did something like that happen？ A friend？
Maybe something happened at home... it might be good to hear them out.
Hey, ▲高嶺＊＊▲. Would ▲高嶺＊＊▲ ever go to a convenience store late at night...
Seems an underclassman hangs out there a lot, so I'm worried...
It really is dangerous. There might be a reason... but I don't think it's good.
Hey, ▲高嶺＊＊▲. If an older coworker at your part-time job invited you to dinner, what would you do？
Huh, I don't know much about part-time jobs... but isn't that a good thing？
They probably want to get along with you, I think.
If you work together, I think trust is important.
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲... maybe she trusts me a little.)
At my part-time job, they asked me to come up with ideas for a new menu item.
Huh, amazing. So part-timers even do things like that...
You think so too. I don't think that's normal, though.
That means the shop trusts you that much, right？ That really is amazing.
(I can't just leave it all to ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...)
If you promise to go out with someone, you have to keep it, right？
Of course. You absolutely have to keep your promises.
Breaking a promise once you've made it is irresponsible, I think.
(Well, that's true... what do I do about my promise with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...)
Um... am I in the way？
I was remembering all sorts of things. From before.
Yeah, how we met, all the things that happened, how we started going out...
Remembering all that, I realized. I really do love ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
I'm really glad I'm going out with ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Me too. I'm so glad I became your girlfriend.
